text: dsh-prompt-bar 是面向 DSH Web 对话界面的会话提问辅助插件。它在聊天内容顶部固定显示当前会话的首条提问，并提供可展开的历史面板；列表按时间展示用户发送的提问，可复制原文，也可点击条目定位到对应消息。用户还能选择十种明暗外观、切换动效，偏好会保存在浏览器本地。插件通过 DSH 会话接口读取历史，并在接口不可用时显示已加载的对话内容。适合需要回看长会话开场问题、快速复制或返回某条提问的 DSH Web 用户；需要 DSH 版本 >=0.2.1-rc.1，不需额外密钥。

dsh-prompt-bar pins a session's first prompt above the DSH Web chat. Expand a chronological prompt list to copy a question or jump to its message. Choose ten looks and toggle motion; preferences are stored locally. It reads DSH session history and requires DSH >=0.2.1-rc.1.
想让当前会话的第一条问题一直显示在聊天顶部。
能不能快速找到并复制我之前发过的提问？
让 DSH 的长对话可以列出所有历史提问。
我想点一下列表中的问题，就回到聊天里对应的位置。
会话开场问了什么？我希望不用往上翻很久。
Keep my session's opening prompt visible while I scroll through the chat.
Show me a list of the questions I sent earlier in this conversation.
Jump back to a particular question without manually paging through old messages.
dsh-prompt-bar 的功能「首条提问常驻」：在聊天内容顶部显示会话的第一条提问，页面滚动时仍可查看，并可一键复制原文。
dsh-prompt-bar 的功能「历史提问面板」：点击展开按钮查看按先后排列的用户提问，可复制单条内容或点击条目定位到聊天消息。
dsh-prompt-bar 的功能「外观与动效」：打开面板中的外观选择器可切换十种明暗样式，并单独启用或关闭界面动效；选择会保存在本地。
dsh-prompt-bar 的功能「旧提问定位」：点击历史列表中的提问后，插件按会话序号加载较早消息并寻找对应行；找到后滚动定位并短暂高亮。
dsh-prompt-bar 使用浏览器 localStorage 保存首条提问记录和外观偏好；记录仅按插件逻辑写入本地存储。
dsh-prompt-bar 的提问跳转依赖当前 DSH 会话接口；若接口不可用或旧消息正文已被压缩，历史列表可能不完整或无法定位。

dsh-prompt-bar README · dsh-prompt-bar：[中文](README.zh.md)

This plugin lets you see (and copy) the first prompt you sent in a DSH agent session at a glance, with a collapsible panel listing every prompt you have sent. Designed to be minimal! Works with any DSH client that shows the Web GUI.

dsh-prompt-bar README · Screenshots：**1 — Collapsed bar.** At the top of the Chat (对话) tab, one pinned row shows the session's first prompt — here `hello` — prefixed by its ordinal and a `首条提问` ("first prompt") tag, with a copy icon and an expand icon on the right. The chat bubble below it (`hello`, sent 05:19) is the normal DSH conversation flow: the bar sits above the conversation and, by design, never scrolls away, no matter how far you scroll.

dsh-prompt-bar README · Screenshots：**2 — Expanded panel.** Clicking the expand icon opens a panel directly under the bar, titled `全部提问 · 共 3 条` ("all prompts · 3 total") with a × close button. It lists exactly the three prompts the user sent — `hello` (05:19, 5 characters), `今天的中东局势如何?` (10 characters), `今天的石油价格如何?` (10 characters) — each row numbered and timestamped with its own copy icon. Model answers are not listed: the long answer about the Mideast ceasefire visible below the panel is part of the normal chat, simply pushed down while the panel is open (it expands inline instead of floating, so nothing is ever hidden behind it). The footer spells out the interaction rules: `Esc 收起` / `点击面板外的区域同样收起` (press Esc or click anywhere outside the panel to collapse), `复制 = 原文写入剪贴板` (copy puts the raw prompt text on the clipboard).

dsh-prompt-bar README · Screenshots：**3 — Appearance picker.** The slider icon in the panel header (left of ×, lit here because the picker is open) opens an appearance picker directly under the header: ten looks — **four light ones first, then six dark ones** — each drawn as a mini preview of the bar, with **Reset** beside the section title `外观` ("appearance"). The look in use — `亮四 · 藕荷` here, a pale lilac — is outlined and carries a check badge in its corner, and the pinned bar at the top of the shot is wearing exactly that look; the cursor is resting on the `亮二 · 桃腮` tile. The switch on the bottom row turns the motion effects on or off without touching any color; the label says plainly which effects exist at all (badge glow, copy flash, hover light sweep — only some looks have them, and the sweeping band is on 亮一 · 靛青纸 and 亮二 · 桃腮). Clicking a swatch repaints the bar on the spot — no restart, no reload — and the pick is remembered for the next time you open DSH.

dsh-prompt-bar README · Usage：| Action | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Bar right, 2nd icon (box with down arrow) | Expand the full-prompt panel; the icon stays lit while it is open |
| Click the same icon again | Collapse |
| × at the right of the panel header | Collapse |
| Click anywhere outside the panel (rest of DSH, message area, composer…) | Collapse |
| Press `Esc` | Collapse |
| Copy icon on the bar | First prompt's raw text goes to the clipboard; the icon ticks to a check mark |
| Hover a panel row and click its small copy icon | That prompt's raw text goes to the clipboard |
| Click a panel row (anywhere but its copy icon) | The panel collapses and the conversation jumps to that prompt, a frame flashing around it; if it was folded out of the loaded window, older history is paged in on the spot first (a short "loading" badge shows while it works) |
| Slider icon in the panel header (left of ×) | Open the appearance picker; click the same icon again to close |
| Click a swatch in the appearance picker | The bar takes that look immediately — no restart — and the choice is remembered |

dsh-prompt-bar README · Usage：The panel lists only prompts **you** sent — injected context, wake-up context, time context and compact checkpoints are all excluded — oldest first; prompts later overwritten are dropped. Everything stays local: records live in `localStorage` under the session id, no network requests, no telemetry.

dsh-prompt-bar README · Usage：**Ten switchable looks.** The picker holds ten presets — four light ones first (indigo paper, blush, mint paper, lilac), then six dark ones (ink, phosphor, tide, ember, night violet, half-band), each shown as a mini preview of the bar. The light looks sit on a pale gradient and are meant to be readable text on a light card inside DSH's dark window; the switch's own colors follow whichever look is active. Switching is instant and needs no restart — every look's CSS ships in the plugin and picking one only changes a class — and your pick is remembered in `localStorage` next to the prompt records. **Reset** returns to the default (ink, a dark look). The switch in the picker's footer turns the motion effects on or off without changing any color, and its label states plainly that only some looks have them: badge glow and copy flash live in phosphor, the sweeping band of light in indigo paper and blush. A system-wide "reduce motion" setting is respected automatically. All colors are the plugin's own CSS variables (`--fpb-*`), so you can override any of them from your own user styles.

dsh-prompt-bar README · Installation：- In the plugin market (dshmarket), install `dsh-prompt-bar` with one click; or run `dsh plugin add dsh-prompt-bar`.
- **After installing, restart the whole DSH application.** `Ctrl+R` / `F5` only reload the page; the client module graph is fixed when the web service starts, so without a restart the old code keeps running.
- Requires DSH `>=0.2.1-rc.1` (developed and tested on DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 / DSH Desktop 0.12.1).

dsh-prompt-bar README · Known limitations：- **Old sessions (created before this plugin was installed): the first prompt may not come back.** This is a DSH-side limit, not a plugin bug: in long sessions, compaction prunes the bodies of very old events out of the data the client can read. In that case the bar shows the oldest prompt that can still be recovered, and an orange **Incomplete (不完整)** badge appears next to it (hover for the reason). You can manually click **Load older** in that session, refreshing the bar's prompt record until the session's true first prompt appears — once it does, the record is properly saved and never changes again (that is the first prompt in the theoretical sense).
- **Jumping hits the same boundary.** Clicking a panel row jumps to that prompt in the conversation. If its body was already pruned by compaction (only very old prompts get that treatment), there is no rendered position left to point at: the bar shows a short notice instead of scrolling somewhere random. The same applies to a first prompt remembered from a session that predates the plugin, when its position was never recorded.
